source: tacenta-spec/protocol/session-establishment.md (Keys; Publishing keys; Sending the initial message; Receiving the initial message; Replay; The fingerprint); tacenta-spec/protocol/key-deletion.md (Establishing a session; Prekeys at rest; What this implementation does: one-time prekeys are replenished, a replayed last-resort handshake is refused, signed prekeys rotate); tacenta-spec/protocol/session-persistence.md (Session; Prekey store); tacenta-spec/protocol/error-handling.md (Conditions a caller must act on are named); independent clean-room author: Jie Sun, P6 round two; ratchet.md (Sending and receiving; Skipped keys, 'A message whose ratchet key equals DHr, whose number N is below Nr, and whose key is not stored is not accepted'); mlkem-braid.md (Failure; 'Session puts nothing from a failed Braid on the wire: it refuses encrypt and decrypt with AgreementFailed'); session-persistence.md (Session, Semantic rules, 'A failed Braid (tag 11) is exempt'); session-establishment.md (Sending the initial message: 'Alice verifies every signature in the bundle and aborts if any fails'; Notation: 'Both sides refuse a Diffie-Hellman output that is not contributory'; Byte-level conventions / KEM validation, 'She has then computed no agreement and sent nothing')

traces.comment: Family 1: create, publish, replenish, and each rotation, showing a retired key retained after the first rotation and then dropped after the second (key-deletion.md, Signed prekeys rotate).

fixtures.bob-store: the prekey store create-prekey-store below produces: create_prekeys(n=1) for Bob's identity -- signed prekey id 1, one one-time curve prekey id 2, last-resort KEM prekey id 3, one one-time KEM prekey id 4, next_id 5 (key-deletion.md, One-time prekeys are replenished)

traces.comment: Family 1: the identifier ceiling. key-deletion.md: replenish 'adds nothing further and keeps what it has added' once next_id is u32::MAX, and each rotation 'returns without rotating, silently' at the same ceiling.

fixtures.store-at-ceiling: a prekey store whose next_id already stands at u32::MAX (key-deletion.md, One-time prekeys are replenished, identifier space end)

traces.comment: Family 2: initiator establishment with a one-time curve prekey (session-establishment.md, Sending the initial message).

fixtures.bob-bundle-with-otpk: Bob's published bundle, carrying a one-time curve prekey and a one-time KEM prekey

traces.comment: Family 2: initiator establishment against a bundle with no one-time curve prekey, the last-resort KEM path (session-establishment.md, Sending the initial message; Replay).

fixtures.bob-bundle-no-otpk: Bob's published bundle, with no one-time curve prekey and the last-resort KEM prekey named

traces.comment: Family 2: responder establishment consumes exactly the named one-time curve and KEM prekeys, only once the initial ciphertext has authenticated (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message; key-deletion.md, Establishing a session).

fixtures.bob-store: Bob's prekey store, holding the one-time curve and KEM prekeys named below
fixtures.alice-initial-with-otpk: Alice's initial message naming Bob's signed prekey, one one-time curve prekey and one one-time KEM prekey, whose ciphertext authenticates

traces.comment: Family 2: responder establishment on the last-resort path -- no one-time curve prekey, the last-resort KEM prekey reused -- and the fingerprint is added only after the ciphertext authenticates (session-establishment.md, Replay, The fingerprint).

fixtures.bob-store: Bob's prekey store, one-time curve and KEM pools exhausted, last-resort KEM prekey still live
fixtures.alice-initial-last-resort: Alice's initial message naming no one-time curve prekey and Bob's last-resort KEM prekey, never seen before, whose ciphertext authenticates

traces.comment: Families 2 and 3: a forged initial message fails to authenticate; SK is aborted and deleted, and the prekey store is left exactly as it found it -- no one-time key is deleted (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message; key-deletion.md, 'a message that fails to authenticate leaves the store as it found it').

fixtures.bob-store: Bob's prekey store, holding the one-time curve and KEM prekeys named below, untouched
fixtures.alice-forged-initial: an initial message naming the same prekeys as alice-initial-with-otpk, whose AEAD tag does not verify under the derived SK

traces.comment: Family 4: a one-time KEM prekey defends itself by deletion on use, so a fresh establish-responder attempt naming an already-consumed one-time prekey fails as a no-op. error-handling.md leaves the error type to the implementation and names no refusal for this case, so expect carries no `refusal` field.

fixtures.bob-store-after-establish: Bob's store after establish-responder consumed the one-time curve and KEM prekeys named by alice-initial-with-otpk
fixtures.alice-initial-with-otpk-replayed: the identical bytes of alice-initial-with-otpk, offered again with no existing responder session to recognise it as a repeat (e.g. the application dropped that session)

traces.comment: Family 4: a captured last-resort initial message, replayed against the fingerprint record, is refused (session-establishment.md, Replay, The fingerprint; key-deletion.md, 'A replayed last-resort handshake is refused').

fixtures.bob-store-with-fingerprint: Bob's store, whose last-resort replay record already holds the fingerprint of an earlier accepted handshake
fixtures.alice-last-resort-initial-replayed: the identical bytes of that earlier accepted last-resort initial message

traces.comment: Family 4: a last-resort key whose replay record already holds MAX_LAST_RESORT_SEEN entries refuses a new, never-seen handshake before anything is decrypted or changed (key-deletion.md, 'it never evicts... is refused (LastResortRecordFull)').

fixtures.bob-store-record-full: Bob's store, whose current last-resort KEM key's replay record already holds MAX_LAST_RESORT_SEEN entries
fixtures.alice-new-last-resort-initial: a fresh, never-seen last-resort initial message naming that same last-resort KEM key

traces.comment: Family 5: a repeat of the message that established a responder session is not refused; it decrypts the inner ratchet message once (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message).

fixtures.bob-established-session: Bob's responder session, established from alice-initial-with-otpk, whose inner ratchet message has not yet been read a second time
fixtures.alice-initial-with-otpk-repeat: the identical bytes of alice-initial-with-otpk, sent again before Bob's first reply reaches Alice

traces.comment: Family 5: an initiator's session always refuses an initial message as not a repeat (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message, 'always on an initiator's session').

fixtures.alice-initiator-session: Alice's own initiator session, still pending Bob's reply
fixtures.carol-initial-to-alice: an initial message addressed to Alice from a third party, or from Bob under simultaneous initiation

traces.comment: Family 5: a responder session refuses an initial message whose ephemeral differs from the one that established it -- a session reset (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message, 'A session reset, or a changed identity').

fixtures.bob-established-session: Bob's responder session, established from alice-initial-with-otpk
fixtures.alice-reset-initial: an initial message from Alice with a new ephemeral key, the same identity key

traces.comment: Family 5: a responder session refuses an initial message whose identity differs from the one that established it (session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message, 'and, after a changed identity, a new identity').

fixtures.bob-established-session: Bob's responder session, established from alice-initial-with-otpk
fixtures.alice-changed-identity-initial: an initial message with a new identity key and a new ephemeral key

traces.comment: Family 6: restoring a prekey store from exported bytes and continuing to replenish it confirms the restored next_id sequence carries forward (session-persistence.md, Prekey store; key-deletion.md, One-time prekeys are replenished).

fixtures.bob-store-exported: Bob's prekey store, exported to bytes before a restart
fixtures.bob-store-restored: the store restore-prekey-store below reads back from bob-store-exported

traces.comment: Family 6: restoring a session from exported bytes and sending on it confirms the restored session continues (session-persistence.md, Session; triple-ratchet.md, Sending and receiving).

fixtures.alice-session-exported: Alice's established session, exported to bytes before a restart
fixtures.alice-session-restored: the session restore-session below reads back from alice-session-exported

traces.comment: Control C1 (deliberately wrong expected effect). The step and its refusal are exactly establish-responder-with-one-time-curve-prekey's, but this trace falsely claims the one-time curve prekey survives. session-establishment.md and key-deletion.md require it deleted once the ciphertext authenticates. A conformant checker must flag this trace as contradicting the cited source, not pass it.

fixtures.alice-initial-with-otpk: Alice's initial message naming Bob's signed prekey, one one-time curve prekey and one one-time KEM prekey, whose ciphertext authenticates

traces.comment: Control C2 (missing required input). establish-responder cannot be checked against the source without the initial message it is receiving: `inputs` omits `message` on purpose. A conformant checker must refuse to score this step rather than silently pass it.

traces.comment: Family 7 main case: later-message-first delivery stores a skipped key, a late arrival recovers it, and a replay of an already-used message is refused without changing the session (ratchet.md, Skipped keys; Sending and receiving).

fixtures.message-2-replayed: the identical bytes of message-2-first, delivered again after message 2 has already been read

Same duplicate-replay step as receive-out-of-order-then-recovery-then-duplicate-refused's last step, but this trace falsely claims it is accepted a second time. ratchet.md requires a message whose key has already been used and is not stored to be refused, unchanged.

traces.comment: Family 8, all three parts in one arc: an authenticated receive whose Braid MAC check fails enters the terminal Failed state (the outer message still authenticates and is accepted -- mlkem-braid.md, Failure); the session is exported and restored, and the persisted Failed state survives (session-persistence.md, Session, Semantic rules, 'A failed Braid (tag 11) is exempt'); a later operation on the restored session is refused (mlkem-braid.md, 'Session puts nothing from a failed Braid on the wire').

fixtures.message-with-failing-braid-mac: a message whose outer ratchet AEAD tag authenticates but whose Braid header or ciphertext MAC does not verify, moving the Braid to Failed
fixtures.failed-session-exported: the session, with its now-Failed Braid, exported to bytes
fixtures.failed-session-restored: the session restore-session below reads back from failed-session-exported
fixtures.next-plaintext: a plaintext the application attempts to send after restoring

traces.comment: Family 9: a bundle whose prekey is a low-order point yields a non-contributory Diffie-Hellman output, refused before SK is used for anything (session-establishment.md, Notation, 'Both sides refuse a Diffie-Hellman output that is not contributory, which a low-order public key produces').
